title: Add a "Leave group" button
text:
Beta testers had no way to leave a group that wasn't working for them, so they just stopped showing up and the rest of the group was left waiting.

**Acceptance**

* "Leave group" in the group menu with a confirmation dialog
* The seat is freed and offered to the waiting list
* Remaining members get a short notice that someone left
* The student can be matched again right away

Tomas says this was the second most requested thing after room booking.
